en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small town along a river. On the left, steep rocky hills and dense trees descend toward clustered houses with pitched roofs. In the middle distance stand church spires and a tower on a hill. The river curves from the foreground on the right toward a bridge and the town center in the background. The caption printed in the upper right reads "Camburg a. Saale".
